name: Extended morphology
description: Petrosian radii (3 eta), Petrosian flux, R20/R50/R80/R90, concentration, Kron radius/magnitude, noise-corrected smoothness, Petrosian-segmented Gini/M20 and growth curves with neighbour handling. Merger / interaction indicators: rotational asymmetry, multiple peaks, Lotz Gini-M20 class, shells, tidal tails and catalog pair classification.

steps.label: Extended Morphology (Petrosian, Kron, S, growth curves)
steps.title: Extended morphology

steps.label: Merger / Tidal Features (asymmetry, shells, tails, pairs)
steps.title: Merger and tidal-feature indicators

params.name: mx-eta
params.label: Petrosian eta
params.help: Petrosian ratio defining R_P (MX_RP); Petrosian flux = flux inside 2 R_P, R20..R90 and C are fractions of it.

params.name: mx-kron-scale
params.label: Kron aperture scale
params.help: Flux aperture = scale x Kron radius (SExtractor MAG_AUTO uses 2.5).

params.name: mx-kron-min
params.label: Kron min. radius (px)
params.help: Smallest semi-major axis of the Kron flux aperture.

params.name: mx-smooth-frac
params.label: Smoothness box (x R_P)
params.help: Width of the boxcar of the smoothness / clumpiness S in units of the Petrosian radius.

params.name: mx-circular
params.label: Circular apertures
params.help: Use circular apertures instead of the catalog ellipse (A_IMAGE, B_IMAGE, THETA_IMAGE).

params.name: mx-fill-neighbours
params.label: Mask neighbours
params.help: Mask the other catalog objects (ellipses of neighbour radius x A_IMAGE) inside the aperture of the target; masked pixels are replaced by the azimuthal mean.

params.name: mx-neighbour-radius
params.label: Neighbour mask radius (x A_IMAGE)
params.help: Semi-axis of the masked neighbour ellipse.

params.name: mx-rmax
params.label: Max. radius (px)
params.help: Largest semi-major axis of the growth curve.

params.name: mx-curves
params.label: Growth-curve plots
params.help: Number of brightest objects in the growth-curve / eta plot (0 = none).

params.name: mx-feat-nsig
params.label: Feature significance (sigma)
params.help: Residual shells / tails must exceed this many sigma of the smoothed residual of the elliptical-median model.

params.name: mx-asym-merger
params.label: Asymmetry merger limit
params.help: Rotational asymmetry (background corrected, Conselice 2003) above which an object is flagged as merger.

params.name: mx-pair-sep
params.label: Pair separation (x sum of R_P)
params.help: Companions closer than this multiple of the sum of the two Petrosian radii are pairs.

params.name: mx-pair-major
params.label: Major-pair flux ratio
params.help: Companion/target flux ratio (either direction) from which a pair is a major pair (1:4).

params.name: mx-pair-minor
params.label: Minor-pair flux ratio
params.help: Flux ratio limit of minor pairs (1:10).
